Note the dot at the very end, which can usually be omitted. Reading a domain name from back to front, .com is the top-level domain, chenshaowen is the second-level domain, and www is the communication protocol.

item.title: An Overview of Anonymous Networks
item.description: Anonymous communication was proposed by Chaum, who put forward an anonymous communication algorithm based on Mix nodes. A Mix node receives messages from multiple senders, mixes and processes these messages, and then transmits them to the receivers, thereby concealing the identity information of the senders and receivers and achieving anonymity.
